Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a game art direction REVIEW BOARD, not an implemented screenshot.
Create an elegant landscape 3:2 six-panel board for a warm western harbor bartender game, Chinese title “原造型 · 精细像素重绘”, small subtitle “器具与瓶装酒风格预览”. Dark desaturated brown/ink-blue flat board, thin brass pixel borders, cream readable labels.
Image1 and2: SHAPE REFERENCES ONLY. Keep their silver tapered three-piece cobbler shaker, golden hourglass double jigger, straight mixing glass with RIGHT pouring spout, tall straight highball with thick transparent base, wide shallow stemmed coupe. Images3 and4: SHAPE AND LABEL IDENTITY ONLY for the square-shouldered pale blue GIN bottle with cream juniper label and navy cap, and rounded cobalt BLEU DE MINUIT bottle with cork and dark oval gold-edged botanical label. Do not redesign their shape. Image5: PIXEL GRAMMAR reference only; make the pixel grid about 2x finer than this reference's crude icons.
Critical: redraw from scratch as actual carefully hand-placed 16-bit pixel sprites. Clearly visible clean square pixel clusters; each tall object about 90–120 logical pixels high, enlarged nearest-neighbor with crisp 3–4 display-pixel steps. 6–8 deliberately selected shades per material, NO continuous gradients, NO smooth vector outlines, NO photographic textures, NO painterly/speckled/dithered high-frequency noise, NO photoreal rendering. Must look recognizably pixel art even at normal viewing size, much more developed and nuanced than generic 32px inventory icons. Never simply downsample or blur the references.
Top row panels: silver shaker with cap correctly seated, and separate small open lid/cap beside it (label “三件式摇壶”); golden double jigger with small pixel 15/30 scale marks (label “量酒器”); mixing glass with right spout, half filled amber translucent liquid (label “搅拌杯”).
Bottom row: tall highball with three distinct translucent ice cubes and pale drink, plus shallow stemmed coupe beside it (label “成品杯”); faithful pale blue GIN bottle (label “伦敦干金酒”); faithful cobalt bottle (label “午夜蓝草本酒”).
Materials: metal uses broken stepwise champagne/steel/silver bands, warm rim light and cool shadow. Glass edges are delicate 1 logical pixel white/teal/amber broken highlights, thin stepped ellipses, transparent center shows flat panel backdrop; thick base gets 2–3 distinct bands. Liquid translucent color blocks and delicate pixel glints, NOT an opaque plastic fill. Bottle botanical labels simplified into legible pixel motifs; retain original layouts and character. No people, no hands, no new fantasy props. Keep generous margins, all objects fully visible. Review illustration only.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: full game screen design preview for a first person 2D bartender workstation, wide16:9.
Image 1 is the exact game layout and object SHAPE/composition reference to EDIT. Image 2 is the approved-direction pixel MATERIAL treatment to use for the working objects.
REDRAW the foreground items in image1 as refined 16-bit pixel sprites, matching image2's clearly visible stepped pixel edges and deliberate clustered material shading. Preserve original dimensions, positions and identity: open tapered silver shaker bottom center-left with its separate domed lid and cap to its right, golden double jigger below-center, transparent straight mixing glass with RIGHT spout bottomleft, pale blue square GIN bottle and rounded cobalt BLEU DE MINUIT bottle behind shaker, tall narrow straight highball glass with thick base upperright of working area. Right pantry contains small pixel versions of those same familiar materials. Keep shapes and proportions from image1, no generic redesigned fantasy tools.
Pixel density: main shaker approx90 logicalpixels tall at native size, jigger60, highball90, bottles100; represent these with about2 visible displaypixels per logicalpixel at a1280px-wide game screenshot, keep edge steps obvious. At normal viewing size viewer MUST see actual pixel art, NOT high-resolution handpainting, NOT smooth vector art, NOT photoreal objects pasted on pixel background. 5–8 shades per metal; no noisy microdots. Glass is finer than the reference2's big outlines: mostly ONE logical pixel rim highlights, stepped ellipses, sparse narrow white/warmgrey/coolteal highlights, transparent center; distinct thick base. Use block shapes for the ice with 3 transparent tones, show pale liquid lower half of highball. NO smooth gradients or blur or antialias. Bottle original labels simplified into pixel botanical patterns and short legible words.
Keep warm western harbor saloon background, existing parchment note upperleft, upper navigation strip, work mat, bottom instruction panel, six pantry category tabs upperright. Same first-person no-hands arrangement and spatial functions as image1. Keep the background relatively quiet so tools read clearly. No new characters or new interfaces. UI text cream paper/darkbrown. Clear readable Chinese labels “配方参考”, “返回 Esc”, “记录 R”, “重做 N”, “仓库 B”, “商店 S”, “备料柜”, tabs “基酒”“配料”“装饰”“杯子”“冰块”“器具”. Bottom hint “拖动材料到容器 · 空格停止倒入”. This is a CONCEPT PREVIEW, not a functional screenshot; no extra labels over the center, no branding beyond original bottle labels. Match image2 color/material grammar throughout the foreground objects.
